endorsements.name: Ziming Zhang
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-36280
endorsements.description: An out-of-bounds(OOB) memory access vulnerability was found in vmwgfx driver in drivers/gpu/vmxgfx/vmxgfx_kms.c in GPU component in the Linux kernel with device file '/dev/dri/renderD128 (or Dxxx)'. This flaw allows a local attacker with a user account on the system to gain privilege, causing a denial of service(DoS).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.3)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
